what: three concave r5 rounds at the inner corner of a 20x20x10 notch, with the g2 corner patch
method: the notch's inner corner (40,20,10), three concave edges, set back by its ellipsoid scaled to fit the notch's 10 mm vertical edge (1.25 sqrt 2 r = 8.84 and its ease 1.55 would take 10.39; the scale 1.1785 gives 8.33 and 1.67, just under 10) and filled with six biquintic patches about a centre point, built G2 to the rounds, the faces and each other; one valid body with the faces of the ball corner but its sphere (12) and the six patches (18); across every seam of the corner, along its whole length, its ends included, the curvature jump is at most 1e-6 per mm (the ball's corner jumps 1/r = 0.2; within 11 mm of the corner: the hole reaches 8.33 sqrt 2; the vertical round, 1.67 mm long past its setback, meets its faces 11.2 mm out, with the G1 jump every round has)
